integrity: The proof reduces every possible projective symmetry to the exact order-eight stabilizer of the conic triple by a generalized-eigenvalue argument, then performs a finite exact line-action check. The accompanying checker replays only the finite and spectral steps and is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the two explicit degree-eight arrangements of Construction 2.2. It does not classify the realization space, the abstract combinatorial automorphism group, or projective stabilizers of all realizations.
title: Different projective isotropy in the degree-eight conic-line Zariski pair
